word: take the dog for a walk
definition: to go out walking with your dog
exampleSentence: I take the dog for a walk after dinner.
exampleTranslation: Sau bữa tối tôi dắt chó đi dạo.

definition: to wash the place where a small animal or bird lives
exampleSentence: I clean the cage every weekend.
exampleTranslation: Cuối tuần nào tôi cũng dọn lồng.

definition: to remove dirt from the box where a cat goes to the toilet
exampleSentence: It is my job to clean the litter box.
exampleTranslation: Việc dọn khay cát cho mèo là của tôi.

definition: to brush and clean your dog's fur
translation: chải lông và chăm sóc cho chó
exampleSentence: We groom the dog every Sunday.
exampleTranslation: Chủ nhật nào chúng tôi cũng chải lông cho chó.

definition: to wash your dog with water
exampleSentence: I bathe the dog once a month.
exampleTranslation: Mỗi tháng tôi tắm cho chó một lần.

definition: to teach a young dog to do things
exampleSentence: It takes time to train a puppy.
exampleTranslation: Huấn luyện chó con cần thời gian.

word: take the pet to the vet
definition: to take your animal to the animal doctor
translation: đưa thú cưng đi khám thú y
exampleSentence: I took the cat to the vet yesterday.
exampleTranslation: Hôm qua tôi đưa con mèo đi khám thú y.

definition: to open the door so the dog can go outside
exampleSentence: Let the dog out before bed.
exampleTranslation: Thả chó ra ngoài trước khi đi ngủ.

definition: to send a ball through the air with your hand
exampleSentence: He throws a ball for the dog.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy ném bóng cho con chó.

definition: to move your hand gently over a cat's fur
exampleSentence: She strokes the cat on her lap.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy vuốt ve con mèo nằm trên đùi.

definition: to give water to the plants in the garden
exampleSentence: I water the garden in the evening.
exampleTranslation: Buổi tối tôi tưới vườn.

definition: to pull out plants you do not want from the ground
exampleSentence: We pull up weeds in spring.
exampleTranslation: Mùa xuân chúng tôi nhổ cỏ dại.

definition: to make a hole in the ground
exampleSentence: Dig a hole for the tree.
exampleTranslation: Đào một cái hố để trồng cây.

definition: to put seeds in the ground so they grow
exampleSentence: We plant seeds in March.
exampleTranslation: Tháng Ba chúng tôi gieo hạt.

definition: to put a young tree in the ground
exampleSentence: They planted a tree in the garden.
exampleTranslation: Họ trồng một cái cây trong vườn.

definition: to produce vegetables in a garden
exampleSentence: My grandfather grows vegetables.
exampleTranslation: Ông tôi trồng rau.

definition: to take flowers from plants
exampleSentence: The girls picked flowers in the field.
exampleTranslation: Các cô bé hái hoa ngoài cánh đồng.

definition: to take fruit from a tree or plant
exampleSentence: We picked fruit in the orchard.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi hái trái cây trong vườn.

definition: to collect fallen leaves with a rake
exampleSentence: I rake the leaves in autumn.
exampleTranslation: Mùa thu tôi cào lá rụng.

definition: to cut the hedge to keep it neat
exampleSentence: He trims the hedge every month.
exampleTranslation: Tháng nào bố cũng tỉa hàng rào cây.

definition: to move a plant into a bigger pot
exampleSentence: I repotted the plant last week.
exampleTranslation: Tuần trước tôi thay chậu cho cái cây.

definition: to give food to the fish in a tank
exampleSentence: I feed the fish every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng cho cá ăn.

definition: to cook food outside on a fire and eat it with friends
exampleSentence: We had a barbecue in the garden.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi tổ chức tiệc nướng trong vườn.
